//go:build windows

package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf16"
	"unsafe"

	"golang.org/x/sys/windows"
)

// These declarations let the probe reuse the controller's Windows process owner.
type child interface {
	Input() io.WriteCloser
	Output() io.ReadCloser
	Errors() io.ReadCloser
	Done() <-chan struct{}
	Result() error
	PID() uint32
	Finish() (bool, error)
}
type platform interface {
	Preflight() (map[string]any, error)
	Start(string, []string, string) (child, error)
}

var newPlatform func() (platform, error)

const mappingByteLimit = 1 << 20
const mappingRowLimit = 128

type mappingOwner struct {
	SID              string `json:"sid"`
	AuthenticationID string `json:"authentication_id"`
	WindowsBuild     uint32 `json:"windows_build"`
}
type mappingRow struct {
	LocalPath  string `json:"local_path"`
	RemotePath string `json:"remote_path"`
	Status     string `json:"status"`
}
type mappingSnapshot struct {
	Owner         mappingOwner        `json:"owner"`
	Rows          []mappingRow        `json:"rows"`
	Devices       map[string][]string `json:"dos_devices"`
	LogicalDrives uint32              `json:"logical_drives"`
}
type mappingLedger struct {
	Version          int             `json:"version"`
	RunID            string          `json:"run_id"`
	SourceSHA        string          `json:"source_sha"`
	Nonce            string          `json:"fixture_nonce"`
	Volume           string          `json:"volume"`
	Sequence         uint64          `json:"sequence"`
	Owner            mappingOwner    `json:"owner"`
	LocalPath        string          `json:"local_path"`
	RemotePath       string          `json:"remote_path"`
	TCPPort          uint16          `json:"tcp_port_argument"`
	Transport        string          `json:"transport_argument"`
	RequireIntegrity bool            `json:"require_integrity_argument"`
	Persistent       bool            `json:"persistent_argument"`
	Global           bool            `json:"global_argument"`
	SaveCredentials  bool            `json:"save_credentials_argument"`
	State            string          `json:"state"`
	Baseline         mappingSnapshot `json:"baseline"`
	ObservedRow      *mappingRow     `json:"observed_row,omitempty"`
	ObservedDevice   []string        `json:"observed_dos_device,omitempty"`
}
type mappingFacts struct {
	Ledger          string       `json:"ledger"`
	Owner           mappingOwner `json:"owner"`
	LocalPath       string       `json:"local_path"`
	RemotePath      string       `json:"remote_path"`
	TCPPortArgument uint16       `json:"tcp_port_argument"`
	State           string       `json:"state"`
	DOSDevice       []string     `json:"dos_device"`
}
type mappingBackend interface {
	Snapshot(context.Context) (mappingSnapshot, error)
	Create(context.Context, mappingLedger) error
	Remove(context.Context, mappingLedger, mappingRow) error
}
type mappingLedgerStore interface {
	Create(mappingLedger) error
	Save(mappingLedger) error
}
type ownedSMBMapping struct {
	options options
	path    string
	ledger  mappingLedger
	backend mappingBackend
	store   mappingLedgerStore
}

func (m *ownedSMBMapping) LocalPath() string { return m.ledger.LocalPath }
func (m *ownedSMBMapping) Facts() mappingFacts {
	return mappingFacts{m.path, m.ledger.Owner, m.ledger.LocalPath, m.ledger.RemotePath, m.ledger.TCPPort, m.ledger.State, append([]string(nil), m.ledger.ObservedDevice...)}
}

func mappingOptions(o options) error {
	if !identifier(o.RunID, 64) || !lowerHex(o.SourceSHA, 40) || !lowerHex(o.FixtureNonce, 64) || o.Volume != fixtureVolume || o.Sequence == 0 {
		return errors.New("mapping requires the exact fixture run, source, nonce, volume and sequence")
	}
	if o.Phase != "current-smb-cold" && o.Phase != "current-smb-cleanup" {
		return errors.New("mapping requires an explicit cold or cleanup phase")
	}
	if !filepath.IsAbs(o.StateFile) || filepath.Base(o.StateFile) != "probe-state.json" || filepath.Base(filepath.Dir(o.StateFile)) != "evidence" {
		return errors.New("mapping state must be the private RUN/evidence/probe-state.json")
	}
	for _, path := range []string{filepath.Dir(o.StateFile), filepath.Dir(filepath.Dir(o.StateFile))} {
		if err := validatePrivateDirectory(path); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func matchingRows(snapshot mappingSnapshot, local, remote string) (*mappingRow, error) {
	var selected *mappingRow
	for _, row := range snapshot.Rows {
		if strings.EqualFold(row.LocalPath, local) || strings.EqualFold(row.RemotePath, remote) {
			if row.LocalPath != local || row.RemotePath != remote || selected != nil {
				return nil, errors.New("mapping drive or nonce share has a mismatched or duplicate row")
			}
			copy := row
			selected = &copy
		}
	}
	return selected, nil
}

func checkMappingSnapshot(snapshot mappingSnapshot) error {
	if (!strings.HasPrefix(snapshot.Owner.SID, "S-1-") || len(snapshot.Owner.SID) > 184) || !lowerHex(snapshot.Owner.AuthenticationID, 16) || snapshot.Owner.WindowsBuild < 26100 {
		return errors.New("mapping inventory lacks native owner/logon/build facts")
	}
	if snapshot.LogicalDrives&^uint32((1<<26)-1) != 0 {
		return errors.New("logical-drive inventory contains undefined bits")
	}
	if len(snapshot.Rows) > mappingRowLimit || len(snapshot.Devices) != 26 {
		return errors.New("mapping inventory exceeds bounds or lacks all DOS drives")
	}
	used := map[string]bool{}
	for _, row := range snapshot.Rows {
		if len(row.LocalPath) > 1024 || len(row.RemotePath) > 1024 || len(row.Status) > 128 || row.RemotePath == "" || row.Status == "" {
			return errors.New("mapping row is malformed")
		}
		if row.LocalPath != "" {
			key := strings.ToUpper(row.LocalPath)
			if used[key] {
				return errors.New("mapping inventory contains duplicate drive rows")
			}
			used[key] = true
		}
	}
	for letter := 'A'; letter <= 'Z'; letter++ {
		name := string(letter) + ":"
		targets, ok := snapshot.Devices[name]
		if !ok || len(targets) > 32 {
			return errors.New("DOS drive inventory is incomplete or too large")
		}
		for _, target := range targets {
			if target == "" || len(target) > 8192 {
				return errors.New("DOS drive target is malformed")
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func chooseMappingDrive(snapshot mappingSnapshot) (string, error) {
	if err := checkMappingSnapshot(snapshot); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	for letter := 'Z'; letter >= 'D'; letter-- {
		drive := string(letter) + ":"
		if snapshot.LogicalDrives&(1<<uint(letter-'A')) != 0 || len(snapshot.Devices[drive]) != 0 {
			continue
		}
		free := true
		for _, row := range snapshot.Rows {
			if strings.EqualFold(row.LocalPath, drive) {
				free = false
				break
			}
		}
		if free {
			return drive, nil
		}
	}
	return "", errors.New("no drive is absent from SMB, DOS-device and logical-drive inventories")
}

func preserveMappingBaseline(ledger mappingLedger, now mappingSnapshot) error {
	if err := checkMappingSnapshot(now); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if now.Owner != ledger.Owner {
		return errors.New("mapping cleanup SID or authentication logon changed")
	}
	for _, before := range ledger.Baseline.Rows {
		found := false
		for _, row := range now.Rows {
			if row.LocalPath == before.LocalPath && row.RemotePath == before.RemotePath {
				found = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !found {
			return errors.New("a baseline SMB mapping disappeared or changed")
		}
	}
	for drive, targets := range ledger.Baseline.Devices {
		if drive == ledger.LocalPath {
			continue
		}
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(targets, now.Devices[drive]) {
			return errors.New("a baseline DOS device changed")
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func beginSMBMapping(ctx context.Context, o options, share string, port uint16, backend mappingBackend, store mappingLedgerStore, path string) (*ownedSMBMapping, error) {
	if share != "rfs-"+o.FixtureNonce || port == 0 || o.Phase != "current-smb-cold" {
		return nil, errors.New("mapping requires the exact nonce share and nonzero custom port")
	}
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	baseline, err := backend.Snapshot(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	drive, err := chooseMappingDrive(baseline)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	remote := `\\127.0.0.1\` + share
	if row, err := matchingRows(baseline, drive, remote); err != nil || row != nil {
		return nil, errors.Join(errors.New("mapping baseline already contains the requested identity"), err)
	}
	ledger := mappingLedger{Version: 1, RunID: o.RunID, SourceSHA: o.SourceSHA, Nonce: o.FixtureNonce, Volume: o.Volume, Sequence: o.Sequence, Owner: baseline.Owner, LocalPath: drive, RemotePath: remote, TCPPort: port, Transport: "TCP", RequireIntegrity: true, State: "intent", Baseline: baseline}
	if err := store.Create(ledger); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	owned := &ownedSMBMapping{o, path, ledger, backend, store}
	// An intent is recoverable ownership, never permission to resume a failed create.
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return owned, err
	}
	if err := backend.Create(ctx, ledger); err != nil {
		return owned, err
	}
	ledger.State = "create-returned"
	if err := store.Save(ledger); err != nil {
		return owned, err
	}
	owned.ledger = ledger
	now, err := backend.Snapshot(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return owned, err
	}
	if err := preserveMappingBaseline(ledger, now); err != nil {
		return owned, err
	}
	row, err := matchingRows(now, drive, remote)
	if err != nil {
		return owned, err
	}
	if row == nil || row.Status != "OK" || len(now.Devices[drive]) == 0 {
		return owned, errors.New("mapping creation did not produce an exact connected row and DOS device")
	}
	ledger.State = "observed"
	ledger.ObservedRow = row
	ledger.ObservedDevice = append([]string(nil), now.Devices[drive]...)
	if err := store.Save(ledger); err != nil {
		return owned, err
	}
	owned.ledger = ledger
	return owned, nil
}

func (m *ownedSMBMapping) cleanup(ctx context.Context) error {
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	now, err := m.backend.Snapshot(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := preserveMappingBaseline(m.ledger, now); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	row, err := matchingRows(now, m.ledger.LocalPath, m.ledger.RemotePath)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	targets := now.Devices[m.ledger.LocalPath]
	if row == nil {
		if len(targets) != 0 || now.LogicalDrives&(1<<uint(m.ledger.LocalPath[0]-'A')) != 0 {
			return errors.New("mapping row is absent but a DOS or logical drive remains; refusing device deletion")
		}
		if m.ledger.State == "intent" {
			return errors.New("mapping create outcome is unknown; present absence does not prove provider quiescence")
		}
		m.ledger.State = "removed"
		return m.store.Save(m.ledger)
	}
	if m.ledger.State == "removed" {
		return errors.New("a mapping reappeared after confirmed removal; refusing adoption")
	}
	if m.ledger.ObservedRow != nil && !reflect.DeepEqual(m.ledger.ObservedDevice, targets) {
		return errors.New("mapping DOS device differs from its recorded binding")
	}
	// Recovery can release an exact post-intent row, but cannot convert cold failure to success.
	if m.ledger.ObservedRow == nil {
		m.ledger.ObservedRow = row
		m.ledger.ObservedDevice = append([]string(nil), targets...)
		if err := m.store.Save(m.ledger); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if err := m.backend.Remove(ctx, m.ledger, *row); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	after, err := m.backend.Snapshot(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := preserveMappingBaseline(m.ledger, after); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	remaining, err := matchingRows(after, m.ledger.LocalPath, m.ledger.RemotePath)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if remaining != nil || len(after.Devices[m.ledger.LocalPath]) != 0 || after.LogicalDrives&(1<<uint(m.ledger.LocalPath[0]-'A')) != 0 {
		return errors.New("mapping removal did not clear its row and DOS device")
	}
	m.ledger.State = "removed"
	return m.store.Save(m.ledger)
}

type diskMappingStore struct {
	path     string
	o        options
	expected mappingLedger
}

func mappingLedgerPath(o options) string {
	return filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(o.StateFile), "smb-mapping.json")
}

func validateMappingLedger(ledger mappingLedger, o options) error {
	if ledger.Version != 1 || ledger.RunID != o.RunID || ledger.SourceSHA != o.SourceSHA || ledger.Nonce != o.FixtureNonce || ledger.Volume != o.Volume || ledger.Sequence == 0 || ledger.Sequence != o.Sequence {
		return errors.New("mapping ledger belongs to another run, source, nonce, volume or sequence")
	}
	if len(ledger.LocalPath) != 2 || ledger.LocalPath[0] < 'D' || ledger.LocalPath[0] > 'Z' || ledger.LocalPath[1] != ':' || ledger.RemotePath != `\\127.0.0.1\rfs-`+o.FixtureNonce || ledger.TCPPort == 0 {
		return errors.New("mapping ledger drive, nonce share or custom port is invalid")
	}
	if ledger.Transport != "TCP" || !ledger.RequireIntegrity || ledger.Persistent || ledger.Global || ledger.SaveCredentials {
		return errors.New("mapping ledger arguments differ from private signed nonpersistent mapping")
	}
	if ledger.State != "intent" && ledger.State != "create-returned" && ledger.State != "observed" && ledger.State != "removed" {
		return errors.New("mapping ledger state is invalid")
	}
	if err := checkMappingSnapshot(ledger.Baseline); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if ledger.Owner != ledger.Baseline.Owner {
		return errors.New("mapping ledger owner differs from its baseline")
	}
	letter := ledger.LocalPath[0]
	if len(ledger.Baseline.Devices[ledger.LocalPath]) != 0 || ledger.Baseline.LogicalDrives&(1<<uint(letter-'A')) != 0 {
		return errors.New("mapping ledger attempts to own a baseline DOS drive")
	}
	row, err := matchingRows(ledger.Baseline, ledger.LocalPath, ledger.RemotePath)
	if err != nil || row != nil {
		return errors.Join(errors.New("mapping ledger attempts to adopt a baseline mapping"), err)
	}
	if ledger.ObservedRow != nil && (ledger.ObservedRow.LocalPath != ledger.LocalPath || ledger.ObservedRow.RemotePath != ledger.RemotePath) {
		return errors.New("mapping ledger observation differs from its intent")
	}
	if ledger.State == "observed" && (ledger.ObservedRow == nil || len(ledger.ObservedDevice) == 0) {
		return errors.New("observed mapping lacks its exact row and DOS binding")
	}
	return nil
}

func uniqueMappingJSON(data []byte) error {
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
	var value func(int) error
	value = func(depth int) error {
		if depth > 16 {
			return errors.New("mapping JSON nesting exceeds limit")
		}
		token, err := decoder.Token()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		delimiter, nested := token.(json.Delim)
		if !nested {
			return nil
		}
		if delimiter != '{' && delimiter != '[' {
			return errors.New("mapping JSON has an unexpected delimiter")
		}
		keys := map[string]bool{}
		for decoder.More() {
			if delimiter == '{' {
				keyToken, err := decoder.Token()
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				key, ok := keyToken.(string)
				if !ok || keys[key] {
					return errors.New("mapping JSON has duplicate or invalid fields")
				}
				keys[key] = true
			}
			if err := value(depth + 1); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		_, err = decoder.Token()
		return err
	}
	return value(0)
}

func decodeMappingJSON(data []byte, target any) error {
	if len(data) > mappingByteLimit {
		return errors.New("mapping JSON exceeds size limit")
	}
	if err := uniqueMappingJSON(data); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var trailing any
	if err := decoder.Decode(&trailing); err != io.EOF {
		return errors.New("mapping JSON must contain exactly one value")
	}
	return nil
}

func readMappingLedger(path string, o options) (mappingLedger, error) {
	var ledger mappingLedger
	if err := validatePrivateFile(path); err != nil {
		return ledger, err
	}
	file, err := os.Open(path)
	if err != nil {
		return ledger, err
	}
	data, readErr := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, mappingByteLimit+1))
	closeErr := file.Close()
	if err := errors.Join(readErr, closeErr); err != nil {
		return ledger, err
	}
	if err := decodeMappingJSON(data, &ledger); err != nil {
		return ledger, err
	}
	var fields map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &fields); err != nil {
		return ledger, err
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"version", "run_id", "source_sha", "fixture_nonce", "volume", "sequence", "owner", "local_path", "remote_path", "tcp_port_argument", "transport_argument", "require_integrity_argument", "persistent_argument", "global_argument", "save_credentials_argument", "state", "baseline"} {
		value, ok := fields[name]
		if !ok || bytes.Equal(bytes.TrimSpace(value), []byte("null")) {
			return ledger, fmt.Errorf("mapping ledger lacks %s", name)
		}
	}
	return ledger, validateMappingLedger(ledger, o)
}

func writeMappingFile(file *os.File, ledger mappingLedger) error {
	data, err := json.Marshal(ledger)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if len(data)+1 > mappingByteLimit {
		return errors.New("mapping ledger exceeds size limit")
	}
	if err := makePrivateFile(file.Name()); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err = file.Write(append(data, '\n'))
	return errors.Join(err, file.Sync())
}

func (s *diskMappingStore) Create(ledger mappingLedger) error {
	if err := validateMappingLedger(ledger, s.o); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	file, err := os.OpenFile(s.path, os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY, 0600)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	result := errors.Join(writeMappingFile(file, ledger), file.Close())
	if result == nil {
		s.expected = ledger
	}
	return result
}

func (s *diskMappingStore) Save(ledger mappingLedger) error {
	if err := validateMappingLedger(ledger, s.o); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	current, err := readMappingLedger(s.path, s.o)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(current, s.expected) {
		return errors.New("mapping ledger changed while owned")
	}
	file, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(s.path), ".smb-mapping-")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	temporary := file.Name()
	if err := errors.Join(writeMappingFile(file, ledger), file.Close()); err != nil {
		return errors.Join(err, os.Remove(temporary))
	}
	from, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(temporary)
	if err != nil {
		return errors.Join(err, os.Remove(temporary))
	}
	to, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(s.path)
	if err != nil {
		return errors.Join(err, os.Remove(temporary))
	}
	if err := windows.MoveFileEx(from, to, windows.MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING|windows.MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH); err != nil {
		return errors.Join(err, os.Remove(temporary))
	}
	s.expected = ledger
	return nil
}

func lockMappingLedger(o options) (func() error, error) {
	path := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(o.StateFile), "smb-mapping.lock")
	file, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL|os.O_RDWR, 0600)
	if errors.Is(err, os.ErrExist) {
		if err := validatePrivateFile(path); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		file, err = os.OpenFile(path, os.O_RDWR, 0)
	} else if err == nil {
		if sealErr := makePrivateFile(path); sealErr != nil {
			return nil, errors.Join(sealErr, file.Close())
		}
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var position windows.Overlapped
	if err := windows.LockFileEx(windows.Handle(file.Fd()), windows.LOCKFILE_EXCLUSIVE_LOCK|windows.LOCKFILE_FAIL_IMMEDIATELY, 0, 1, 0, &position); err != nil {
		return nil, errors.Join(err, file.Close())
	}
	return func() error {
		return errors.Join(windows.UnlockFileEx(windows.Handle(file.Fd()), 0, 1, 0, &position), file.Close())
	}, nil
}

func newSMBMapping(ctx context.Context, o options, share string, port uint16) (owned *ownedSMBMapping, resultErr error) {
	if err := mappingOptions(o); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	unlock, err := lockMappingLedger(o)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer func() { resultErr = errors.Join(resultErr, unlock()) }()
	backend, err := newNativeMappingBackend(o)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	path := mappingLedgerPath(o)
	return beginSMBMapping(ctx, o, share, port, backend, &diskMappingStore{path: path, o: o}, path)
}

func (m *ownedSMBMapping) Cleanup(ctx context.Context) (resultErr error) {
	if err := mappingOptions(m.options); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	unlock, err := lockMappingLedger(m.options)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { resultErr = errors.Join(resultErr, unlock()) }()
	current, err := readMappingLedger(m.path, m.options)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	m.ledger = current
	m.store = &diskMappingStore{path: m.path, o: m.options, expected: current}
	return m.cleanup(ctx)
}

func cleanupSMBMapping(ctx context.Context, o options) (resultErr error) {
	if err := mappingOptions(o); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	unlock, err := lockMappingLedger(o)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { resultErr = errors.Join(resultErr, unlock()) }()
	path := mappingLedgerPath(o)
	ledger, err := readMappingLedger(path, o)
	if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
		return nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	backend, err := newNativeMappingBackend(o)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	owned := &ownedSMBMapping{o, path, ledger, backend, &diskMappingStore{path: path, o: o, expected: ledger}}
	return owned.cleanup(ctx)
}

type mappingTokenStatistics struct {
	TokenID            windows.LUID
	AuthenticationID   windows.LUID
	Expiration         int64
	TokenType          uint32
	ImpersonationLevel uint32
	DynamicCharged     uint32
	DynamicAvailable   uint32
	GroupCount         uint32
	PrivilegeCount     uint32
	ModifiedID         windows.LUID
}

func currentMappingOwner() (mappingOwner, error) {
	var layout mappingTokenStatistics
	if unsafe.Sizeof(layout) != 56 || unsafe.Alignof(layout) != 8 || unsafe.Offsetof(layout.AuthenticationID) != 8 || unsafe.Offsetof(layout.ModifiedID) != 48 {
		return mappingOwner{}, errors.New("TOKEN_STATISTICS differs from the Windows 64-bit ABI")
	}
	token := windows.GetCurrentProcessToken()
	user, err := token.GetTokenUser()
	if err != nil {
		return mappingOwner{}, err
	}
	var elevation uint32
	var returned uint32
	if err := windows.GetTokenInformation(token, windows.TokenElevation, (*byte)(unsafe.Pointer(&elevation)), 4, &returned); err != nil {
		return mappingOwner{}, err
	}
	if returned != 4 || elevation != 1 {
		return mappingOwner{}, errors.New("alternate-port SMB mapping requires an elevated administrator token")
	}
	groups, err := token.GetTokenGroups()
	if err != nil {
		return mappingOwner{}, err
	}
	administrator := false
	for _, group := range groups.AllGroups() {
		if group.Sid.IsWellKnown(windows.WinBuiltinAdministratorsSid) && group.Attributes&windows.SE_GROUP_ENABLED != 0 && group.Attributes&windows.SE_GROUP_USE_FOR_DENY_ONLY == 0 {
			administrator = true
		}
	}
	if !administrator {
		return mappingOwner{}, errors.New("alternate-port SMB mapping requires enabled Administrators membership")
	}
	var statistics mappingTokenStatistics
	if err := windows.GetTokenInformation(token, windows.TokenStatistics, (*byte)(unsafe.Pointer(&statistics)), uint32(unsafe.Sizeof(statistics)), &returned); err != nil {
		return mappingOwner{}, err
	}
	if returned != uint32(unsafe.Sizeof(statistics)) {
		return mappingOwner{}, errors.New("token statistics returned an unexpected size")
	}
	logon := fmt.Sprintf("%08x%08x", uint32(statistics.AuthenticationID.HighPart), statistics.AuthenticationID.LowPart)
	return mappingOwner{user.User.Sid.String(), logon, windows.RtlGetVersion().BuildNumber}, nil
}

func requireMappingJob() error {
	var limits windows.JOBOBJECT_EXTENDED_LIMIT_INFORMATION
	var returned uint32
	if err := windows.QueryInformationJobObject(0, windows.JobObjectExtendedLimitInformation, uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&limits)), uint32(unsafe.Sizeof(limits)), &returned); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("mapping requires the inherited F child job: %w", err)
	}
	if returned != uint32(unsafe.Sizeof(limits)) {
		return errors.New("immediate job limits returned an unexpected size")
	}
	flags := limits.BasicLimitInformation.LimitFlags
	if flags&windows.JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE == 0 || flags&(windows.JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_BREAKAWAY_OK|windows.JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_SILENT_BREAKAWAY_OK) != 0 {
		return errors.New("mapping requires an immediate kill-on-close job without breakaway")
	}
	return nil
}

type nativeMappingBackend struct {
	o                  options
	owner              mappingOwner
	host               platform
	executable, module string
}

func newNativeMappingBackend(o options) (mappingBackend, error) {
	host := windowsPlatform{}
	if _, err := host.Preflight(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := requireMappingJob(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	owner, err := currentMappingOwner()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	system, err := windows.GetSystemDirectory()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	executable := filepath.Join(system, "WindowsPowerShell", "v1.0", "powershell.exe")
	module := filepath.Join(system, "WindowsPowerShell", "v1.0", "Modules", "SmbShare", "SmbShare.psd1")
	for _, path := range []string{executable, module} {
		if err := rejectPrivateReparsePath(path); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
			return nil, errors.New("system PowerShell executable or SMB module is not regular")
		}
	}
	return &nativeMappingBackend{o, owner, host, executable, module}, nil
}

func mappingDOSTarget(drive string) ([]string, error) {
	name, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(drive)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	buffer := make([]uint16, 8192)
	count, err := windows.QueryDosDevice(name, &buffer[0], uint32(len(buffer)))
	if errors.Is(err, windows.ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND) {
		return nil, nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if count < 2 || count > uint32(len(buffer)) || buffer[count-1] != 0 {
		return nil, errors.New("DOS device returned malformed MULTI_SZ")
	}
	var targets []string
	start := 0
	for i := 0; i < int(count); i++ {
		if buffer[i] != 0 {
			continue
		}
		if i == start {
			if i != int(count)-1 {
				return nil, errors.New("DOS device returned trailing target data")
			}
			break
		}
		raw := buffer[start:i]
		for j := 0; j < len(raw); j++ {
			if raw[j] >= 0xd800 && raw[j] <= 0xdbff {
				if j+1 >= len(raw) || raw[j+1] < 0xdc00 || raw[j+1] > 0xdfff {
					return nil, errors.New("DOS target has an unpaired UTF-16 surrogate")
				}
				j++
			} else if raw[j] >= 0xdc00 && raw[j] <= 0xdfff {
				return nil, errors.New("DOS target has an unpaired UTF-16 surrogate")
			}
		}
		targets = append(targets, string(utf16.Decode(raw)))
		start = i + 1
		if len(targets) > 32 {
			return nil, errors.New("DOS target count exceeds limit")
		}
	}
	if len(targets) == 0 {
		return nil, errors.New("DOS device exists without a target")
	}
	return targets, nil
}

type mappingCommandRequest struct {
	Action     string `json:"action"`
	Module     string `json:"module"`
	OwnerSID   string `json:"owner_sid"`
	LocalPath  string `json:"local_path"`
	RemotePath string `json:"remote_path"`
	TCPPort    uint16 `json:"tcp_port"`
}
type mappingCommandResult struct {
	Status   string       `json:"status"`
	OwnerSID string       `json:"owner_sid"`
	Rows     []mappingRow `json:"rows"`
	Cause    string       `json:"cause"`
}

const mappingPowerShell = `
[Console]::Error.WriteLine('RFS-MAPPING/1 entry')
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$WarningPreference = 'Stop'
$ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'
Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
[Console]::InputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$OutputEncoding = [Console]::OutputEncoding
$owner = ''
try {
    [Console]::Error.WriteLine('RFS-MAPPING/1 before-readline')
    $requestLine = [Console]::In.ReadLine()
    [Console]::Error.WriteLine('RFS-MAPPING/1 after-readline')
    [Console]::Error.WriteLine('RFS-MAPPING/1 before-json')
    $request = $requestLine | ConvertFrom-Json
    [Console]::Error.WriteLine('RFS-MAPPING/1 after-json')
    [Console]::Error.WriteLine('RFS-MAPPING/1 before-owner')
    $owner = [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent().User.Value
    [Console]::Error.WriteLine('RFS-MAPPING/1 after-owner')
    if ($owner -cne $request.owner_sid) { throw 'PowerShell primary-token SID differs from mapping owner.' }
    [Console]::Error.WriteLine('RFS-MAPPING/1 before-import')
    Import-Module -Name $request.module -ErrorAction Stop
    [Console]::Error.WriteLine('RFS-MAPPING/1 after-import')
    function Read-Mappings {
        [Console]::Error.WriteLine('RFS-MAPPING/1 before-inventory')
        $items = @(Get-SmbMapping -ErrorAction Stop)
        [Console]::Error.WriteLine('RFS-MAPPING/1 after-inventory')
        if ($items.Count -gt 128) { throw 'SMB mapping inventory exceeds 128 rows.' }
        @($items | ForEach-Object {
            [ordered]@{ local_path = [string]$_.LocalPath; remote_path = [string]$_.RemotePath; status = [string]$_.Status }
        })
    }
    if ($request.action -eq 'create') {
        [Console]::Error.WriteLine('RFS-MAPPING/1 before-create-inventory')
        $prior = @(Get-SmbMapping -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.LocalPath -ieq $request.local_path -or $_.RemotePath -ieq $request.remote_path })
        [Console]::Error.WriteLine('RFS-MAPPING/1 after-create-inventory')
        if ($prior.Count -ne 0) { throw 'Refusing to adopt a pre-existing drive or nonce share mapping.' }
        $command = Get-Command -Name SmbShare\New-SmbMapping -ErrorAction Stop
        if (-not $command.Parameters.ContainsKey('TcpPort')) { throw 'New-SmbMapping lacks alternate TCP-port support.' }
        $null = SmbShare\New-SmbMapping -LocalPath $request.local_path -RemotePath $request.remote_path -TcpPort $request.tcp_port -TransportType TCP -RequireIntegrity $true -Persistent $false -GlobalMapping:$false -SaveCredentials:$false -ErrorAction Stop
    } elseif ($request.action -eq 'remove') {
        [Console]::Error.WriteLine('RFS-MAPPING/1 before-remove-inventory')
        $matching = @(Get-SmbMapping -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.LocalPath -ieq $request.local_path -or $_.RemotePath -ieq $request.remote_path })
        [Console]::Error.WriteLine('RFS-MAPPING/1 after-remove-inventory')
        if ($matching.Count -ne 1 -or $matching[0].LocalPath -cne $request.local_path -or $matching[0].RemotePath -cne $request.remote_path) { throw 'Mapping changed before exact removal; refusing deletion.' }
        $matching[0] | SmbShare\Remove-SmbMapping -Force -UpdateProfile:$false -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction Stop
    } elseif ($request.action -ne 'inventory') { throw 'Unknown mapping command.' }
    $rows = @(Read-Mappings)
    [ordered]@{ status = 'ok'; owner_sid = $owner; rows = $rows; cause = '' } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress
    [Console]::Error.WriteLine('RFS-MAPPING/1 after-result')
} catch {
    $cause = $_.Exception.Message
    if ($cause.Length -gt 1024) { $cause = $cause.Substring(0,1024) }
    [ordered]@{ status = 'error'; owner_sid = $owner; rows = @(); cause = $cause } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress
    exit 1
}
`

var mappingSpawnMu sync.Mutex

func startMappingPowerShell(host platform, executable string, args []string, directory string) (process child, resultErr error) {
	mappingSpawnMu.Lock()
	defer mappingSpawnMu.Unlock()
	// PowerShell 5.1 reads this before startup; NUL disables its AppData module cache.
	// https://github.com/MicrosoftDocs/PowerShell-Docs/blob/2a4b9570939a97008d5039b9b318f6e8585338bb/reference/5.1/Microsoft.PowerShell.Core/About/about_Environment_Variables.md#L356
	old, present := os.LookupEnv("PSModuleAnalysisCachePath")
	if err := os.Setenv("PSModuleAnalysisCachePath", "NUL"); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer func() {
		var err error
		if present {
			err = os.Setenv("PSModuleAnalysisCachePath", old)
		} else {
			err = os.Unsetenv("PSModuleAnalysisCachePath")
		}
		resultErr = errors.Join(resultErr, err)
	}()
	return host.Start(executable, args, directory)
}

const mappingDiagnosticStreamLimit = 2 << 10

type mappingBoundedBuffer struct {
	buffer   bytes.Buffer
	observed int64
	prefix   []byte
}

func (b *mappingBoundedBuffer) Bytes() []byte { return b.buffer.Bytes() }
func (b *mappingBoundedBuffer) Len() int      { return b.buffer.Len() }

func (b *mappingBoundedBuffer) Write(data []byte) (int, error) {
	b.observed += int64(len(data))
	if len(b.prefix) < mappingDiagnosticStreamLimit {
		b.prefix = append(b.prefix, data[:min(len(data), mappingDiagnosticStreamLimit-len(b.prefix))]...)
	}
	if len(data) > mappingByteLimit-b.Len() {
		return 0, errors.New("mapping command output exceeds 1 MiB")
	}
	return b.buffer.Write(data)
}

type mappingStreamDiagnostic struct {
	ObservedBytes   int64  `json:"observed_bytes"`
	PrefixBase64    string `json:"prefix_base64"`
	PrefixTruncated bool   `json:"prefix_truncated"`
}

func (b *mappingBoundedBuffer) diagnostic() mappingStreamDiagnostic {
	return mappingStreamDiagnostic{b.observed, base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(b.prefix), b.observed > int64(len(b.prefix))}
}

type mappingCommandDiagnostic struct {
	Action                    string                  `json:"action"`
	ActionTruncated           bool                    `json:"action_truncated"`
	PID                       *uint32                 `json:"pid,omitempty"`
	ElapsedMillis             int64                   `json:"elapsed_ms"`
	PreCleanupDone            *bool                   `json:"pre_cleanup_done,omitempty"`
	PreCleanupResult          *string                 `json:"pre_cleanup_result_error,omitempty"`
	PreCleanupResultTruncated bool                    `json:"pre_cleanup_result_error_truncated"`
	WriteStarted              bool                    `json:"write_started"`
	WriteReturned             bool                    `json:"write_returned"`
	WriteComplete             bool                    `json:"write_complete"`
	InputBytes                int                     `json:"input_bytes"`
	InputSHA256               string                  `json:"input_sha256"`
	ScriptUTF16Units          int                     `json:"script_utf16_units"`
	ScriptSHA256              string                  `json:"script_utf16le_sha256"`
	WriteBytes                int                     `json:"write_bytes"`
	WriteError                string                  `json:"write_error"`
	WriteErrorTruncated       bool                    `json:"write_error_truncated"`
	EOFRequested              bool                    `json:"eof_requested"`
	EOFAttempted              bool                    `json:"eof_attempted"`
	EOFCompleted              bool                    `json:"eof_completed"`
	EOFError                  string                  `json:"eof_error"`
	EOFErrorTruncated         bool                    `json:"eof_error_truncated"`
	WorkersStarted            int                     `json:"workers_started"`
	WorkersJoined             int                     `json:"workers_joined"`
	CleanupAttempted          bool                    `json:"cleanup_attempted"`
	CleanupConfirmed          bool                    `json:"cleanup_confirmed"`
	CleanupForced             bool                    `json:"cleanup_forced"`
	CleanupError              string                  `json:"cleanup_error"`
	CleanupErrorTruncated     bool                    `json:"cleanup_error_truncated"`
	Launch                    *windowsLaunchFacts     `json:"launch,omitempty"`
	Stdout                    mappingStreamDiagnostic `json:"stdout_observed"`
	Stderr                    mappingStreamDiagnostic `json:"stderr_observed"`
}

type mappingExecution struct {
	Stdout     []byte
	Diagnostic mappingCommandDiagnostic
}

type mappingDiagnosticError struct {
	details mappingCommandDiagnostic
	encoded string
}

func (e *mappingDiagnosticError) Error() string { return "mapping command diagnostic: " + e.encoded }

func mappingDiagnosticText(value string, limit int) (string, bool) {
	if len(value) > limit {
		return value[:limit], true
	}
	return value, false
}

func encodeMappingDiagnostic(details mappingCommandDiagnostic) error {
	data, err := json.Marshal(details)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("encode mapping command diagnostic: %w", err)
	}
	if len(data) >= 16<<10 {
		return errors.New("mapping command diagnostic exceeded 16 KiB")
	}
	return &mappingDiagnosticError{details: details, encoded: string(data)}
}

// The caller runs inside the watchdog-owned probe or tagged diagnostic test.
func executeMappingPowerShell(ctx context.Context, host platform, executable, directory string, request mappingCommandRequest, scriptSource string, closeInput bool) (execution mappingExecution, resultErr error) {
	started := time.Now()
	var process child
	var stdout, stderr mappingBoundedBuffer
	var streams chan error
	drained := 0
	diagnostic := &execution.Diagnostic
	diagnostic.EOFRequested = closeInput
	diagnostic.CleanupConfirmed = true
	diagnostic.Action, diagnostic.ActionTruncated = mappingDiagnosticText(request.Action, 64)
	var writeStarted, writeReturned, eofAttempted, resultObserved bool
	var writeBytes int
	var writeErr, eofErr, processErr error
	defer func() {
		var launchError *windowsLaunchError
		if errors.As(resultErr, &launchError) {
			facts := launchError.Facts
			diagnostic.Launch = &facts
			diagnostic.CleanupConfirmed = facts.CleanupConfirmed
		}
		if process != nil {
			if observer, ok := process.(interface{ LaunchFacts() windowsLaunchFacts }); ok {
				facts := observer.LaunchFacts()
				diagnostic.Launch = &facts
			}
			pid := process.PID()
			diagnostic.PID = &pid
			done := false
			select {
			case <-process.Done():
				done = true
			default:
			}
			diagnostic.PreCleanupDone = &done
			if done {
				if !resultObserved {
					processErr, resultObserved = process.Result(), true
				}
				resultText := ""
				if processErr != nil {
					resultText, diagnostic.PreCleanupResultTruncated = mappingDiagnosticText(processErr.Error(), 512)
				}
				diagnostic.PreCleanupResult = &resultText
			}
			resultErr = errors.Join(resultErr, processErr)
			diagnostic.CleanupAttempted = true
			forced, finishErr := process.Finish()
			diagnostic.CleanupForced = forced
			diagnostic.CleanupConfirmed = finishErr == nil
			if finishErr != nil {
				diagnostic.CleanupError, diagnostic.CleanupErrorTruncated = mappingDiagnosticText(finishErr.Error(), 512)
			}
			resultErr = errors.Join(resultErr, finishErr)
			if forced {
				resultErr = errors.Join(resultErr, errors.New("mapping command required forced owned-job termination"))
			}
			if streams != nil {
				// Finish closes the owned pipes; no capture is read until every worker has joined.
				for drained < 3 {
					resultErr = errors.Join(resultErr, <-streams)
					drained++
				}
			}
		}
		diagnostic.WorkersJoined = drained
		diagnostic.CleanupConfirmed = diagnostic.CleanupConfirmed && drained == diagnostic.WorkersStarted
		diagnostic.ElapsedMillis = time.Since(started).Milliseconds()
		diagnostic.WriteStarted, diagnostic.WriteReturned, diagnostic.WriteBytes = writeStarted, writeReturned, writeBytes
		diagnostic.WriteComplete = writeReturned && writeErr == nil && writeBytes == diagnostic.InputBytes
		diagnostic.EOFAttempted, diagnostic.EOFCompleted = eofAttempted, eofAttempted && eofErr == nil
		if writeErr != nil {
			diagnostic.WriteError, diagnostic.WriteErrorTruncated = mappingDiagnosticText(writeErr.Error(), 512)
		}
		if eofErr != nil {
			diagnostic.EOFError, diagnostic.EOFErrorTruncated = mappingDiagnosticText(eofErr.Error(), 512)
		}
		diagnostic.Stdout, diagnostic.Stderr = stdout.diagnostic(), stderr.diagnostic()
		execution.Stdout = append([]byte(nil), stdout.Bytes()...)
	}()
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return execution, err
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(request)
	if err != nil {
		return execution, err
	}
	if len(data)+1 > 4096 {
		return execution, errors.New("mapping command input exceeds 4 KiB")
	}
	data = append(data, '\n')
	diagnostic.InputBytes = len(data)
	diagnostic.InputSHA256 = fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(data))
	words := utf16.Encode([]rune(scriptSource))
	script := make([]byte, len(words)*2)
	for i, word := range words {
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(script[i*2:], word)
	}
	diagnostic.ScriptUTF16Units, diagnostic.ScriptSHA256 = len(words), fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(script))
	args := []string{"-NoLogo", "-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-EncodedCommand", base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(script)}
	diagnostic.CleanupConfirmed = false
	process, err = startMappingPowerShell(host, executable, args, directory)
	if err != nil {
		return execution, err
	}
	streams = make(chan error, 3)
	diagnostic.WorkersStarted = 3
	go func() { _, err := io.Copy(&stdout, process.Output()); streams <- err }()
	go func() { _, err := io.Copy(&stderr, process.Errors()); streams <- err }()
	go func() {
		writeStarted = true
		writeBytes, writeErr = process.Input().Write(data)
		if writeErr == nil && writeBytes != len(data) {
			writeErr = io.ErrShortWrite
		}
		writeReturned = true
		if closeInput && writeErr == nil {
			eofAttempted = true
			eofErr = process.Input().Close()
		}
		streams <- errors.Join(writeErr, eofErr)
	}()
	done := process.Done()
	finished := false
	for !finished || drained != 3 {
		select {
		case err := <-streams:
			drained++
			if err != nil {
				return execution, err
			}
		case <-done:
			finished = true
			done = nil
			processErr, resultObserved = process.Result(), true
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return execution, ctx.Err()
		}
	}
	return execution, nil
}

func validateMappingResult(data []byte, request mappingCommandRequest) (result mappingCommandResult, resultErr error) {
	if err := decodeMappingJSON(data, &result); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	if request.OwnerSID == "" || result.OwnerSID != request.OwnerSID {
		return result, errors.New("mapping command returned a different primary-token SID")
	}
	if result.Rows == nil {
		return result, errors.New("mapping command omitted its row inventory")
	}
	if result.Status == "ok" && result.Cause != "" {
		return result, errors.New("mapping command returned a failure cause with successful status")
	}
	if result.Status != "ok" {
		return result, fmt.Errorf("mapping %s failed: %s", request.Action, result.Cause)
	}
	if len(result.Rows) > mappingRowLimit {
		return result, errors.New("mapping result row count exceeds limit")
	}
	return result, nil
}

func runMappingPowerShell(ctx context.Context, host platform, executable, directory string, request mappingCommandRequest) (mappingCommandResult, error) {
	execution, commandErr := executeMappingPowerShell(ctx, host, executable, directory, request, mappingPowerShell, false)
	result, validationErr := validateMappingResult(execution.Stdout, request)
	if err := errors.Join(commandErr, validationErr); err != nil {
		return result, errors.Join(err, encodeMappingDiagnostic(execution.Diagnostic))
	}
	return result, nil
}

const mappingStartupEntryScript = `[Console]::Error.WriteLine('RFS-MAPPING/1 entry-only')
[Console]::Out.WriteLine('{"status":"entry-ok"}')
`

type mappingStartupCell struct {
	Name       string
	Script     string
	CloseInput bool
}

func mappingStartupPlan() [4]mappingStartupCell {
	return [4]mappingStartupCell{
		{"01_entry_open", mappingStartupEntryScript, false},
		{"02_entry_eof", mappingStartupEntryScript, true},
		{"03_inventory_open", mappingPowerShell, false},
		{"04_inventory_eof", mappingPowerShell, true},
	}
}

func walkMappingStartupCells(visit func(int, mappingStartupCell) bool) (aborted bool) {
	for index, cell := range mappingStartupPlan() {
		if !visit(index+1, cell) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func (b *nativeMappingBackend) command(ctx context.Context, action string, ledger mappingLedger) (mappingCommandResult, error) {
	if err := requireMappingJob(); err != nil {
		return mappingCommandResult{}, err
	}
	owner, err := currentMappingOwner()
	if err != nil {
		return mappingCommandResult{}, err
	}
	if owner != b.owner {
		return mappingCommandResult{}, errors.New("mapping process SID or logon context changed")
	}
	request := mappingCommandRequest{action, b.module, b.owner.SID, ledger.LocalPath, ledger.RemotePath, ledger.TCPPort}
	commandCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 4*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	result, err := runMappingPowerShell(commandCtx, b.host, b.executable, filepath.Dir(b.o.StateFile), request)
	if err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	after, err := currentMappingOwner()
	if err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	if after != b.owner {
		return result, errors.New("mapping logon context changed during command")
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (b *nativeMappingBackend) Snapshot(ctx context.Context) (mappingSnapshot, error) {
	result, err := b.command(ctx, "inventory", mappingLedger{})
	if err != nil {
		return mappingSnapshot{}, err
	}
	snapshot := mappingSnapshot{Owner: b.owner, Rows: result.Rows, Devices: make(map[string][]string, 26)}
	for letter := 'A'; letter <= 'Z'; letter++ {
		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
			return mappingSnapshot{}, err
		}
		drive := string(letter) + ":"
		targets, err := mappingDOSTarget(drive)
		if err != nil {
			return mappingSnapshot{}, err
		}
		snapshot.Devices[drive] = targets
	}
	snapshot.LogicalDrives, err = windows.GetLogicalDrives()
	if err != nil {
		return mappingSnapshot{}, err
	}
	sort.Slice(snapshot.Rows, func(i, j int) bool {
		if snapshot.Rows[i].LocalPath != snapshot.Rows[j].LocalPath {
			return snapshot.Rows[i].LocalPath < snapshot.Rows[j].LocalPath
		}
		return snapshot.Rows[i].RemotePath < snapshot.Rows[j].RemotePath
	})
	return snapshot, checkMappingSnapshot(snapshot)
}
func (b *nativeMappingBackend) Create(ctx context.Context, ledger mappingLedger) error {
	_, err := b.command(ctx, "create", ledger)
	return err
}
func (b *nativeMappingBackend) Remove(ctx context.Context, ledger mappingLedger, row mappingRow) error {
	if row.LocalPath != ledger.LocalPath || row.RemotePath != ledger.RemotePath {
		return errors.New("removal row differs from owned intent")
	}
	_, err := b.command(ctx, "remove", ledger)
	return err
}
